arg.name: image
arg.description: The image topic. Should be remapped to the name of the real image topic.

arg.name: use_camera_info
arg.description: Indicates that the camera_info topic should be subscribed to to get the default input_frame_id. Otherwise the frame from the image message will be used.

arg.name: debug_view
arg.description: Specify whether the node displays a window to show edge image

arg.name: queue_size
arg.description: Specigy queue_size of input image subscribers

arg.name: apply_otsu
arg.description: Decide applying Otsu's algotirhm threshold. If this value is true, threshold value will be ignored

arg.name: threshold_type
arg.description: Specify threshold types. 0: Binary threshold, 1: Binary inverted threshold, 2: Threshold truncated, 3: Threshold to zero, 4: Threshold to zero inverted

arg.name: max_binary
arg.description: maximum value to use with the 0: Binary thresholding and 1: Binary inverted thresholding types.
